scientific_integrity: Analytic statements supported by a complete extremal-eigenvalue and monotonicity argument; numerical checks supplement but do not certify the infinite-parameter theorem.
scientific_limitations: Exact for a uniform four-vertex diffusion path and equal-price nonnegative additive loadings. Global uniqueness is proved, but no higher-length or unequal-price classification is claimed. Older equivalent literature cannot be ruled out exhaustively.
title: A sharp endpoint-to-interior loading transition for spectral conditioning of a four-site diffusion path
